units.source_text: 薰中纳言派人送信来了。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, sent a messenger with a letter.

units.source_text: 信中说道：“昨夜本拟奉访，但奔走之劳，未蒙酬偿，心中不免怅恨。

en.t: In the letter he wrote: “Last night I had meant to call on you, but all my efforts running about went unrewarded, leaving me inevitably resentful.

units.source_text: 今宵理应前来帮办杂务，但因前晚借宿之处不佳，以致感受风寒，心绪更见恶劣，因此踌躇未决耳。”

en.t: Tonight I ought to come and help with the arrangements, but because the place where I lodged the night before last was poor, I caught a chill and feel even worse, so I remain undecided.”

units.source_text: 信笺用陆奥纸，信笔直书，不讲风趣。

en.t: The letter was written on Michinoku paper, dashed off plainly and directly, with no attempt at elegance.

units.source_text: 新婚第三夜的贺礼，是各种未曾缝制的织物，

en.t: The gifts for the third night after the wedding were various pieces of unsewn fabric,

units.source_text: 折叠成卷，盛在衣柜中的许多套盒内，派人送交老侍女弁君，说是赏赐侍女的衣料。

en.t: folded into rolls and packed in many nested boxes inside a clothing chest; he sent them by messenger to the elderly attendant Ben no Kimi, saying they were cloth to be bestowed on the maids.

units.source_text: 这大约都是他母亲三公主处的现成物品，所以数量并不甚多。

en.t: These were probably ready items from his mother, the Third Princess, and so the quantity was not very large.

units.source_text: 有些未曾练染的绢和绫，塞在底下。

en.t: Some silk and twill that had not yet been scoured or dyed were stuffed underneath.

units.source_text: 上面有赠与两女公子的两套衣服，质料非常精美。

en.t: On top were two sets of robes for the two young ladies, made of exceptionally fine material.

units.source_text: 按照古风，在单衣的袖上题一首诗：

en.t: Following the old custom, he wrote a poem on the sleeve of an unlined robe:
